steps.name: Setup git
steps.script:
git config user.name  "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Install git hooks
steps.script:
nix develop -c bundle exec overcommit --install
nix develop -c bundle exec overcommit --sign pre-commit

steps.name: Update inputs
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail


  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit --no-changelog \
                      '{nixos-stable,production,staging}' nixpkgs
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit --no-changelog nixos-unstable
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit '{staging,os-staging}' vpsadminos
EOF

steps.name: Update llm-agents when Codex changes
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail

  codex_version_expr='let flake = builtins.getFlake (toString ./.); in flake.inputs.llm-agents.packages.x86_64-linux.codex.version'

  current_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --impure --raw \
                              --expr "$codex_version_expr")
  upstream_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --raw \
                               github:numtide/llm-agents.nix#packages.x86_64-linux.codex.version)

  if [ "$current_codex_version" = "$upstream_codex_version" ]; then
    echo "Codex is already up to date at $current_codex_version, skipping llm-agents"
    exit 0
  fi

  echo "Updating llm-agents for Codex $current_codex_version -> $upstream_codex_version"
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" --accept-flake-config -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only \
      --commit --no-changelog llm-agents

  updated_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --impure --raw \
                              --expr "$codex_version_expr")

  if [ "$updated_codex_version" != "$upstream_codex_version" ]; then
    echo "Updated llm-agents contains Codex $updated_codex_version, expected $upstream_codex_version" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
EOF

steps.name: Update package dependencies
steps.script:
set -e

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail

  commit_update() {
    local subject="$1"
    local body="$2"
    local message_file

    message_file=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-commit.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n\n%s\n' "$subject" "$body" > "$message_file"
    git commit -F "$message_file"
    rm -f "$message_file"
  }

  # The dev shell starts with the Bundler version recorded in the
  # lock. Upgrade to the newest release compatible with Ruby 3.4 so
  # the updater itself does not remain pinned indefinitely.
  gem install --no-document bundler
  unset BUNDLER_VERSION
  hash -r

  bundle update --bundler
  bundle lock --update
  bundle install

  # Overcommit signs the merged configuration, including defaults
  # shipped by the gem. Refresh it after upgrading Overcommit.
  bundle exec overcommit --sign

  bundle exec rake spec
  bundle exec rubocop
  bundler-audit check --update

  git add Gemfile.lock

  if ! git diff --cached --quiet ; then
    commit_update \
      "gems: update root dependencies" \
      "Refresh the development and test bundle to current compatible releases."
  fi

  # Bundix unsets BUNDLE_PATH before invoking Bundler. Persist the
  # equivalent setting in a temporary app config so Git gems are not
  # cached in Bundler's read-only Nix store path. Scope the override
  # to Bundix so commit hooks keep using the root development bundle.
  bundix_app_config="$RUNNER_TEMP/bundler-config"
  BUNDLE_APP_CONFIG="$bundix_app_config" \
    bundle config set --local path "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle"

  for pkg in geminabox ssh-exporter syslog-exporter ; do
    pushd "packages/$pkg"

    rm -f gemset.nix Gemfile.lock
    BUNDLE_APP_CONFIG="$bundix_app_config" bundix -l
    nixfmt gemset.nix

    if ! grep -q 'source =' gemset.nix ; then
      echo "Invalid $pkg/gemset.nix: missing sources, skipping"
      popd
      continue
    fi

    git add gemset.nix Gemfile.lock

    if git diff --cached --quiet ; then
      popd
      continue
    fi

    commit_update \
      "$pkg: update dependencies" \
      "Refresh the locked Ruby dependencies and generated Nix gem sources."

    popd
  done
EOF

steps.name: Check and push updates
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail
  git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
    --old-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock" \
    --new-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
EOF
